# dsh-teambition
English | 中文说明

**Bring Teambition into the DeepSeek Harness sidebar.** Browse projects, task
lists and cards inside

DSH, operate them without leaving the GUI, and run any
card in a DSH workspace you pick: the plugin

creates a session in that workspace
and submits the card's title, project, link, updated time and n

ote as the opening
prompt.

- Repository: <https://github.com/Yeezone/dsh-teambition>
- Latest release: `v0.1` (`0.1.0`); `main`

is at `0.7.1`
- License: Apache-2.0
## Why it exists

Work happens in DSH, while tasks and bugs live in Teambition. Switching windows
to read a card, then

pasting its context into a session, is the part worth
automating. The plugin turns Teambition into

context into a session, is the part worth
automating. The plugin turns Teambition into a DSH panel:

1. Click **Teambition** in the sidebar; the panel opens in the main column.
2. Pick a project (and a

task list, for projects with several), then read cards
per kanban column.
3. Click **Run** on a car

d: the plugin creates a session in the bound workspace,
submits the card title, project, link, updat

ed time and note as one queued
prompt, then opens that session.

Where a card runs is configurable: a per-card binding wins, then the project
default, then the panel
-wide default workspace.
## Where it lives in the GUI

- **Sidebar row**: registered on the official `sidebar.panellist` seat, after
"Plugins" and "Automat

ions".
- **Main page**: registered on the official `main` seat, with a Tasks / Board
switcher plus p

roject / task list selectors, refresh and settings.
- **Task list (default unless the default view i

s the board)**: a table close to
the Teambition task module —
task number, title, assignee avatar an

d name, due date (red when overdue), stage
and last update. The toolbar searches, groups by task lis

t / stage / assignee,
filters by open / done / overdue / unassigned state, and sorts by updated,
cre

ated, due or priority. Clicking a row opens the task page: a two-column
property grid (state, assign

ee, creator, participants, priority, story points,
start, due, stage, task list, task type, created

/ updated, attachments), the
note, the (read-only) sub-tasks, the activity feed and custom fields, p

lus the
same run / complete / rebind actions as the board.
- **Board**: the project views of the Tea

mbition web board (for example "All
tasks", a workflow-status view, "My tasks", "Created by me") in

a rail on the
left. A view saved with a workflow vertical renders one column per workflow
status; st

age views render one column group per stage. Every column header has
a "+" that opens the create for

m with that column preselected, and cards carry
their workspace marker plus the actions Run, Complet

e (advance the workflow
status), Open in Teambition and Bind workspace. Completed cards show a green

check before a struck-through title. Cards drag between columns: drop one on
another column to move

it there (workflow status or stage, by the column kind).
- **New card form** at the bottom of the p

anel: title, optional note, target
stage.
- **Task page**: opens from a board card or from a task-li

st row and mirrors the
Teambition task module: properties, note, sub-tasks, activity feed, custom
[该

and mirrors the
Teambition task module: properties, note, sub-tasks, activity feed, custom
[该节后续省略]
## Features

- Task module: a task table (number, title, assignee, due, stage, update time)
with search / groupin

g / filtering / sorting and a full task page; the
chosen view and toolbar settings persist in `local

Storage`.
- Task-list filter: when a project has several lists, the toolbar narrows the
table to one

of them; switching project clears it back to every list.
- Default view: the settings view picks ta

sk list or board, and the panel plus
every project switch open on it.
- Saved views and workflow boa

rds: the board rail lists the project views saved
in Teambition and remembers the selection per proj

ect. Workflow views render
one column per workflow status (the tasks module look), stage views keep

the
stage columns; "executed by me" / "created by me" views filter their cards,
and every column can

quick-add a card.
- Drag and drop: grab a card on the board and drop it on another column to move
i

t there. Workflow status columns update the status, stage columns update the
stage, the hovered colu

mn highlights, and busy cards stay non-draggable.
- Two-level switching (project, then task list). P

rojects with many task lists
are grouped by list instead of flattened into dozens of same-named colu

mns; the
selection is remembered in `localStorage` and restored on the next visit.
- The board view

stays available through the Board tab, with the same card
creation and stage moving as before.
- Car

d actions: run in DSH, complete the card or advance it to the next open
workflow status, open in Tea

mbition, bind an execution workspace. Completed
cards are checked (green check, struck-through title

on the board, a "done"
badge in the task list, a state row in the task page).
- Workspace bindings

with card > project > panel-default precedence, resolved by
the host so the browser half never needs

the full binding table.
- Diagnostics: six candidate endpoints are probed one by one and the HTTP s

tatus
plus verdict of each attempt is shown, which makes an expired cookie or an API
change easy to

spot.
- One model-visible agent tool, `teambition`: list projects, read a project,
create cards, mov

e cards, record workspace bindings.
[该节后续省略]
## Data and privacy

- Host state lives in `$DSH_HOME/teambition/config.json` (mode `0600`): cookie,
operator id, endpoin

t base, workspace bindings, the last diagnose pass, and the
last project list. Writes are atomic (te

mp file + rename).
- The browser half receives `configured` and a four character `cookieTail` only;

the cookie never crosses the host / browser boundary and never reaches
model-visible output.
- Remot

e reads use Teambition's own web REST API through a candidate list plus a
`diagnose` probe rather th

an hardcoded assumptions; response previews are
redacted before they reach the settings view.
- The

plugin writes to Teambition only for explicit actions (create card, change
stage, change status); ru
nning a card only creates a local DSH session.
